description: This Java class defines configuration properties for Prometheus resource limit checks, including host, port, cache sizes, and timeout values.

classes.name: PrometheusBasedResourceLimitChecksConfig
classes.description: Immutable configuration class for Prometheus resource limit checks, providing getters and setters for host, port, cache min/max sizes, and cache timeout.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns the host of the Prometheus server.

methods.name: setHost
methods.description: Sets the host of the Prometheus server, requires non-null input.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port number for Prometheus server.

methods.name: setPort
methods.description: Sets the port number, validating it with PortConfigurationHelper.

methods.name: setCacheMinSize
methods.description: Sets the minimum cache size, must be non-negative.

methods.name: setCacheMaxSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum cache size, must be non-negative.

methods.name: getCacheTimeout
methods.description: Returns the cache timeout period in seconds.

methods.name: setCacheTimeout
methods.description: Sets the cache timeout, must be greater than zero.
